name: Django/DRF fields = '__all__' mass assignment
attack_scenario: A signup or profile-update request includes "is_superuser": true (or "role":"admin"); because the serializer accepts all fields, the value binds and persists, granting the attacker privileges the endpoint never meant to expose.
negative_test_hint: include "is_superuser": true in the signup request body and assert the account is created without superuser privileges

exemplar.explanation: In a ModelForm.Meta or DRF ModelSerializer.Meta, fields = '__all__' auto-binds every model column to client input, so sensitive fields (is_staff, is_superuser, role, balance, owner, is_verified) become writable through the form/API. DRF's own docs warn against '__all__' for this reason; an explicit allowlist of fields is the fix.
